correctness.rationale: For each fixed finite N>=1, the primary construction has h(t)=t-pi/3+delta*phi1(t)+O_N(delta^2) uniformly on the compact angular circle, with phi1(t)=(1+4*cos(2t))/(48*pi) by equation (38). The source radial parametrization is rho=sec(t-h(t)). Thus rho=2+delta*g(t)+O_N(delta^2), where g=-sqrt(3)*(1+4*cos(2t))/(24*pi). Since cos(2t) ranges over [-1,1], min g=-5*sqrt(3)/(24*pi) and max g=sqrt(3)/(8*pi). Uniform remainders bound the max/min errors by O_N(delta^2), with the roles exchanged for negative delta. Rotation introduces no other radial values. Hence the two-sided oscillation coefficient is sqrt(3)/(3*pi), independently of N. This proves all displayed finite-N statements. No convergence as N tends to infinity, infinite-branch counterexample, or second-order coefficient follows.
